intro: "Lost in Battle" is a poignant quest offered by the wounded orc Mankrik at the Crossroads in the Barrens. After a devastating Bristleback quilboar ambush separates him from his wife at a nearby tauren camp, Mankrik asks passing adventurers to search the dangerous scrublands for any sign of her fate.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We battled in a small tauren camp when we were separated--she held three of the Bristlebacks off by herself. But the odds began to overwhelm us. I led some away only to see her overwhelmed by newcomers. In my rage, I turned to face my enemies, but they brought me down easily with their vast numbers.
I awoke to a tauren druid tending my wounds--he had come across me on the Gold Road as I fell.
Please, adventurer, find some sign of my wife.
